Stockfish 19 "full" (single-threaded, full-size NNUE net), by Chess.com, LLC / Nathan Rugg.
Source: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/stockfish (v19.0.0), file bin/stockfish-19-single.js
License: GPLv3

~99 MB wasm binary (full-size net, not the "lite" one). Selectable in the UI
but NOT the default, since that download size is a poor default experience
for most users - see js/engine/stockfishEngine.js.

Vendored here (rather than loaded from a CDN) because browsers refuse to
construct a classic Web Worker from a cross-origin script URL.
